'''Jogotha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] underworld [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and could be found in one of [[Kaas City]]'s [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].
